name: Letta measures which models write memory that improves task pass rate
title: Letta measures which models write memory that improves task pass rate
summary: Letta published measurements from FrontierMemory, a benchmark of whether memory written from past trajectories improves later task performance. Memory written by Opus 5.5 reached a 73.3% full-pass rate, compared with 51.1% for GPT-6.1 Sol and 37.8% for Grok 4.7, using the Letta Dream memory-swarm harness.
